annotations.text:
Direction A · Warm civic — chosen; built out on the Screens page.

Paper background, dark ink, terracotta for actions, green for “free / positive”. Bricolage Grotesque headings, Manrope body, Noto Sans Devanagari for Hindi. 44–56px tap targets for low-literacy, one-handed use.

Tradeoff: the most conventional of the three — friendly and trustworthy, less distinctive.

Direction B · Utility form (sketch, left)

Public-service clarity: numbered steps, thick borders, monochrome with one signal blue, radio lists instead of tiles. Reads instantly, translates trivially.

Tradeoff: feels bureaucratic; the cooperative’s warmth and the “why this worker” story get no room.

Direction C · Bold poster (sketch, right)

One huge word per service, full-bleed bands, tap to choose — no form on the first screen. Very legible, very memorable, great for a demo.

Tradeoff: booking becomes 2–3 screens, and the poster style doesn’t stretch to a dense admin dashboard.
